purpose: Preregistered document-format candidate study after query-only screening; no document outcomes observed

execution_subsets.compact_first: document-hypotheses-compact-v1.json: original control plus four compact layouts
execution_subsets.title_description_if_needed: document-hypotheses-title-description-v1.json: original control plus four title_description layouts
execution_subsets.joint: this complete nine-variant declaration requires both produced document streams

frozen.document_vector_change: new separate indices; preserve old index and model

screening.groups: all contexts of selected normalized texts, including zero-availability queries
screening.comparison: each document/query pair minus new batched dense_current on original document vectors

full_tune_followup.role: exploratory follow-up, not an independent confirmation
full_tune_followup.selection_rule: Within each built document format advance exactly the best of current/plain/values/no_category by conditional-available text-macro candidate Recall; keep R_dense_current as its direct full-Tune control. Ties within1e-12 prefer smaller average realized unique pool, then lexicographic variant name. Losing winners must be reported as losing, not silently discarded.
full_tune_followup.index_schedule: Build/evaluate compact first. The title_description index is a separate declared option and is built only if the remaining retrieval/ranking bottleneck or compact result justifies another index experiment; record that decision before starting its producer, not from Audit outcomes.
full_tune_followup.audit_rule: Do not parse or score the completed Audit labels/report to choose document format, query input, quotas or model settings

inference.candidate_metric: pool upper bound, not new-reranker Recall@50
inference.rrf_reference: unchanged original cached top50, separate reference only

bootstrap.interval: percentile95%; exploratory, not corrected for hypothesis selection

inference.source_scope: same sampled cold catalog and completeGT denominators as other Tune studies; no direct comparison with historical/official scores

provenance.index_identity: corpus identifiers/order plus encoder fingerprint, base-model reference, document-format version and token/word limits
provenance.candidate_channels: ranked unique research-catalog IDs; protocol/cache/source/model file hashes remain bound
